title: Volume Discount Ladder for Invoiced Orders — Northgate Business Invoice Accounts (Net Terms)
content:
**Pricing schedule.** Northgate Business Invoice Accounts (Net Terms) carry a volume discount on an invoiced order's merchandise, set by order subtotal. Each tier's ladder lists subtotal bands, from a lowest to a highest subtotal in US dollars, and the discount percent for an order whose subtotal falls in that band.

| Terms tier | Subtotal $0.00 to $4999.99 | Subtotal $5000.00 to $24999.99 | Subtotal $25000.00 to $999999.99 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Business Net 15 | 0.0 percent | 0.0 percent | 0.0 percent |
| Northgate Business Net 30 Standard | 0.0 percent | 1.0 percent | 1.0 percent |
| Northgate Business Net 30 Preferred | 0.0 percent | 1.0 percent | 2.0 percent |
| Northgate Business Net 45 Volume | 1.0 percent | 2.0 percent | 3.0 percent |
| Northgate Business Net 60 Enterprise | 1.0 percent | 2.0 percent | 4.0 percent |
| Northgate Business Net 30 Public Sector | 2.0 percent | 2.0 percent | 2.0 percent |

**Ladders as published per tier.** Net 15 has a single band, $0.00 to $999999.99, at 0.0 percent. Net 30 Standard has two bands: $0.00 to $4999.99 at 0.0 percent and $5000.00 to $999999.99 at 1.0 percent. Net 30 Preferred, Net 45 Volume and Net 60 Enterprise each have three bands: $0.00 to $4999.99, $5000.00 to $24999.99 and $25000.00 to $999999.99, at the percents shown above. Net 30 Public Sector has a single band, $0.00 to $999999.99, at 2.0 percent.

**Band edges (hypothetical subtotals, Net 45 Volume).**

| Hypothetical order subtotal | Band | Discount percent |
|---|---|---|
| $4999.99 | $0.00 to $4999.99 | 1.0 |
| $5000.00 | $5000.00 to $24999.99 | 2.0 |
| $24999.99 | $5000.00 to $24999.99 | 2.0 |
| $25000.00 | $25000.00 to $999999.99 | 3.0 |
